title: SEAT BACK-TRIM ASM. & PAD
summary: Bucket seat back upholstery: the seat back trim cover (vinyl per the trim chart, or leather) and the foam seat back pad. The cover has sewn-in loops on its inside; the loops are pushed through holes in the pad and two vertical wires plus one horizontal wire are threaded through them on the back of the pad, locking the cover's pleats to the pad (no hog rings or fasteners shown). Related sheets: J3 (frame), J4 (cover attachment), J6 (final trim).

parts.name: CHART-TRIM ??M.
parts.name_expanded: Seat back trim cover – see trim assembly chart (vinyl)

fastening.note: Exploded and ASSEMBLED views: the trim cover [1] has sewn-in loops along its pleat seams (two vertical rows and one short horizontal row). The loops are pushed through the holes in the pad [2] from the front; on the back of the pad the two vertical wires [3] and the horizontal wire [4] are threaded through the loops, pulling the cover's pleats into the pad. No separate clips or hog rings are called out on this sheet.
